solutionStrategy: 先辨識句型、文法或語用任務，再檢查主詞、時態、語序與語意是否同時成立；本題以「Which replacement best checks whether an inferred meaning fits a sentence?」為判讀對象，先圈出條件，再用選項 A 的判準回查（對應 lesson-english-context-clues）。
solutionSteps: 讀題定位：先找出本題要判斷的核心條件與限制；題幹是「Which replacement best checks whether an inferred meaning fits a sentence?」。
建立本題判準：先記下題幹「Which replacement best checks whether an inferred meaning fits a sentence?」的要求，再用答案解析指出的核心理由「Reading the sentence again tests grammar and meaning together.」作為逐項比對標準。
核對正確選項 A：Read the sentence with the guessed meaning。依題目解析，Reading the sentence again tests grammar and meaning together.
逐項檢查語言證據：對照主詞、動詞形式、語序、搭配與語境功能；正解 A「Read the sentence with the guessed meaning」符合「Reading the sentence again tests grammar and meaning together.」，其他選項逐一指出文法或語意衝突。
最後回查：把答案 A「Read the sentence with the guessed meaning」放回完整題幹「Which replacement best checks whether an inferred meaning fits a sentence?」，確認它同時滿足題目要求與解析理由；若條件、數字、語境或資料尺度改變，必須重新建立判準，不可只沿用答案代號。
